news.title: 2025–2028 Provincial, City, Municipal, and Barangay Directories Updated
news.summary: Updated directories of Bukidnon's provincial leadership, 22 mayors and vice mayors, and 464 barangays with source-tier verification statuses are now accessible across the portal.
